records.title: Manifold-Preserving Transformers are Effective for Short-Long Range Encoding
records.reason: TransJect replaces dot-product attention and preserves token distances, but the abstract reports classification/language-model quality and efficient depth scaling rather than measured inference latency, memory, or serving gains; the systems-efficiency connection remains indirect.

records.title: Advances in Transformers for Robotic Applications: A Review
records.reason: The arXiv abstract is a survey of Transformer use in robotic perception, planning, control, and foundation models; it proposes no model-serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: DCT: Dynamic Compressive Transformer for Modeling Unbounded Sequence
records.reason: DCT conditionally retains sentence representations as compressed states or discards them instead of appending every sentence to sequence memory, a concrete long-context memory-compression mechanism transferable to language-model inference.

records.title: Training Dynamics Impact Post-Training Quantization Robustness
records.reason: The study analyzes how training dynamics change post-training quantization robustness for large language models, but it contributes training interventions and quantization-quality analysis rather than a new inference implementation or measured serving-efficiency method.

records.title: A novel approach to attention mechanism using kernel functions: Kerformer
records.reason: Kerformer rewrites attention with kernel feature maps and separate query/key transforms, reducing the attention matrix complexity from quadratic to linear and reporting lower time and memory use on NLP and vision tasks.

records.title: Linear Attention is Enough in Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
records.reason: NSTformer replaces quadratic self-attention with a Nyström approximation of linear complexity for long spatial-temporal sequences, making its attention-computation method transferable to long-context inference.

records.title: Hyper-Compression: Model Compression via Hyperfunction
records.reason: Hyper-Compression represents target-model parameters through a low-dimensional dynamic-system hyperfunction, directly targeting model-size compression as a transferable deployment resource reduction.

records.title: AdaEnsemble: Learning Adaptively Sparse Structured Ensemble Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
records.reason: AdaEnsemble routes each CTR example to sparse experts and exits at a selected feature-interaction depth, explicitly avoiding deeper computation to improve inference efficiency.

records.title: ERNIE-SPARSE: Learning Hierarchical Efficient Transformer Through Regularized Self-Attention
records.reason: ERNIE-Sparse combines hierarchical local/global sparse attention with topology regularization; its abstract positions sparse attention as reducing quadratic sequence-length dependence and reports results against dense and efficient sparse baselines.

records.title: AAN+: Generalized Average Attention Network for Accelerating Neural Transformer
records.reason: AAN+ replaces a decoder self-attention dependency with generalized average attention; the JAIR abstract reports constant-time decoder dependency and roughly 20% faster decoding, a directly transferable autoregressive inference optimization.

records.title: Pruning Laws for Large Language Models
records.reason: The pruning laws predict post-pruning LLM quality from baseline quality and pruning ratio across dense and MoE models, supporting safe pruning choices under the abstract’s stated compute and latency deployment constraints.

records.title: Intra-neuronal attention within language models Relationships between activation and semantics
records.reason: The arXiv abstract studies whether language-model neurons segment activation patterns into semantic categories; it is an interpretability/representation analysis and does not propose inference savings.

records.title: Do Compressed LLMs Forget Knowledge? An Experimental Study with Practical Implications
records.reason: The paper experimentally studies knowledge retention in compressed LLMs and the practical implications of compression, but its contribution is an evaluation of forgetting rather than a compression or serving-efficiency technique.

records.title: Linear Video Transformer with Feature Fixation
records.reason: The video Transformer uses a feature-fixation module to preserve critical features under linear attention and reports fewer parameters and higher efficiency with performance comparable to quadratic Softmax video Transformers.

records.title: NiNformer: a network in network transformer with token mixing generated gating function
records.reason: NiNformer replaces standard ViT attention layers with a Network-in-Network block and token-mixing-generated gates; its abstract states that the block reduces computational requirements, providing a transferable attention-cost reduction design.

records.title: TRA: Better Length Generalisation with Threshold Relative Attention
records.reason: Threshold Relative Attention combines selective sparsity that removes irrelevant keys with contextual relative distance in decoder-only Transformers, a concrete reduction in attended information with direct autoregressive-model applicability.

records.title: (PASS) Visual Prompt Locates Good Structure Sparsity through a Recurrent HyperNetwork
records.reason: PASS uses visual prompts and a recurrent hypernetwork to select acceleration-friendly structural channel sparsity; the abstract reports 0.35x more speedup at comparable accuracy than baselines.

records.title: The Curious Case of In-Training Compression of State Space Models
records.reason: CompreSSM applies balanced truncation to reduce state dimensions during SSM training and reports faster optimization; the abstract does not establish inference-time or serving performance for the compressed models.

records.title: Snakes and Ladders: Two Steps Up for VideoMamba
records.reason: VideoMambaPro addresses self-attention’s compute burden with masked backward computation and residual connections and is described as an efficient Transformer alternative, but the abstract gives accuracy comparisons without inference-time, memory, or latency measurements.
